description: Read a Thalovant runtime group's runtime configuration and personas. Requires the hubs:read scope. The revision returned by this call is used by safe configuration merges.

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.

name: thalovant_get_runtime_group_config
title: Get Runtime Group Config
